title: Cross-Lingual Parkinson's Disease Severity Assessment Using Pre-trained Speech Embeddings: A Multi-Class Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.20875v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) often manifests through speech impairments, facilitating accessible, non-invasive, and cost-effective severity assessment for early diagnosis and progression tracking. Despite advances in speech foundation models (SFMs), their cross-lingual generalization for PD severity multi-class classification remains underexplored due to limited labeled data, a lack of explainable methods and variability across languages and datasets. In this work, we evaluate pre-trained embeddings from four state-of-the-art open-source SFMs across three datasets in zero-shot and k-shot cross-lingual settings for multi-class PD severity assessment. Our results show that pre-trained speech embeddings enable meaningful cross-lingual transfer, although performance is sensitive to dataset properties, preprocessing, and adaptation strategy. translated_title: 使用预训练语音嵌入的跨语言帕金森病严重程度评估：一项多分类评估研究
translated_abstract: 帕金森病（PD）常通过言语障碍表现出来，这为早期诊断和病情进展追踪提供了一种无障碍、非侵入性且低成本的严重程度评估途径。尽管语音基础模型（SFMs）已取得进展，但由于标注数据有限、缺乏可解释的方法以及语言和数据集之间的差异性，这些模型在帕金森病严重程度多分类任务中的跨语言泛化能力仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们评估了来自四个最先进的开源语音基础模型的预训练嵌入，在零样本和k样本跨语言设置下，对三个数据集进行了多分类帕金森病严重程度评估。结果表明，预训练语音嵌入能够实现有意义的跨语言迁移，但其性能对数据集特性、预处理方式和适应策略较为敏感。在这些条件下的误分类与说话人之间的差异以及非典型言语模式有关。
tldr: 本研究评估了四个开源语音基础模型的预训练嵌入在跨语言帕金森病严重程度多分类任务中的表现，证明预训练语音嵌入可实现有效的跨语言迁移，但性能受数据集特性、预处理和适应策略的影响。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates pre-trained embeddings from four open-source speech foundation models for cross-lingual multi-class Parkinson's disease severity assessment, demonstrating that pre-trained speech embeddings enable meaningful cross-lingual transfer, though performance is sensitive to dataset properties, preprocessing, and adaptation strategies.
